conceptual_change: Implement a volatility-gate execution wrapper that requires the 14-period ATR to exceed the 20-period moving average of ATR by a factor of 1.5 as a precondition for entering any trade signals.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The previous attempt (BTC_1h_012) was rejected due to lack of an explicit engine implementation. By formalizing this volatility-gate as a distinct precondition in the execution engine, the hypothesis becomes testable against the baseline performance.
